_about.what: Pieces many moves share, referred to by name from the moves files. Add here when the same measurement, fault or pose would otherwise be typed twice.
_about.measurements: name → { "kind", "pts", "per", "sign", "abs", "flip" }. kinds: "angle" (3 points: the angle at the middle one, 0–180°), "vertical" (2: the segment's angle from hanging straight down, 90 = horizontal), "tilt" (2: from horizontal, 90 = upright), "dist" (2: distance, % of the reference length), "offset" (3: how far the third sits off the line through the first two, % of that line, + = below), "rise" (1: how far the point has risen since calibration, %), "height" (2: how far the first point is above the second, %), "ratio" (2: the segment's length vs calibration, 100 = unchanged — a limb leaving the camera plane reads shorter), "gap" (2: sideways offset of the first point from the second, %; "sign": "outward" = away from the midline, "forward" = the way the toes point), "rotation" (2: how far a segment has swung toward the camera, degrees), "near" (3: distance from the first point to the segment between the others, %), "lean" (0: trunk lean, + = toward the working side, or the way the toes point with "sign": "forward"), "headTilt" (0: head roll against the pelvis), "pelvis" (0: pelvis tilt seen from the front). "per" = what a % is of: "torso" (default) or a segment ["KNEE", "ANK"], measured at calibration. "abs": true ignores the sign. "flip": { "option": "variant", "when": "ir" } negates the reading for that option value. Point names: NOSE EAR SH EL WR HIP KNEE ANK HEEL FOOT on the working side; put o in front for the other side (oKNEE); mEAR mSH mHIP for midpoints.
_about.faults: name → a complete fault. A move writes { "template": "lean", "threshold": 60 } and gets this fault with that threshold; any field the move writes wins over the template's. A template without a threshold requires the move to give one.
_about.poses: name → keyframe angles. A move writes { "preset": "standing", "uarm": 20 } and gets these values with its own on top.
_about.holds: name → a list of hold conditions, used by hold moves as "conditions": "balance".

lean.label: Leaning the trunk
lean.tip: The trunk tipping forward shifts the work to the back and hips. Chest up, look ahead.

fold.label: Trunk folding forward
fold.tip: A little forward lean is normal; folding shifts the load to the lower back.

valgus.label: Knees caving inward
valgus.tip: Screw the feet into the floor and push the knees over the little toes.

kneebend.label: Knees bending too much
kneebend.tip: The knees stay softly bent while the hips travel back; bending them turns it into a squat.

shrug.label: Shrugging the shoulder up
shrug.tip: The shoulder blade should glide, not hike toward the ear. Lower the shoulder before the arm rises.

shrug_lift.label: Shoulders shrugging up
shrug_lift.tip: If the shoulders rise toward the ears, the upper trapezius has taken over. Lower the weight.

swing.label: Upper arm swinging
swing.tip: The upper arm hangs still; only the forearm moves. Swinging is momentum, not muscle.
